# NP-05 · Screen Inventory

> **Screen reuse rule.** Build a new screen from an existing archetype before inventing a layout. Receiving Queue (OPS-RCV-002) and QC Queue (OPS-QC-002) use the same Work Queue (T02) pattern.

## Archetypes

### T01 · Role Home

Beranda sesuai peran: perhatian sekarang dan akses cepat. (Home per role: what needs attention now and quick access.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Operator, Supervisor, Finance, Executive, Client
- Header: Sapaan + nama, peran dan lokasi (Greeting + name, role and site)
- Area status: Kartu angka Level 1 (yang perlu perhatian sekarang) (Level 1 number cards (what needs attention now))
- Konten utama: Frontline: satu CTA utama + daftar tugas. Manajemen: KPI ringkas, alert, drill-down. (Frontline: one main CTA + task list. Management: summary KPI, alerts, drill-down.)
- Memuat (Loading): Kerangka kartu angka tampil dulu; angka masuk setelah data siap. (Number-card skeleton first; numbers fill in when data is ready.)
- Kosong (Empty): Tidak ada tugas. Semua beres untuk saat ini. (No tasks. All clear for now.)
- PC: Sidebar + KPI 4–6 kolom + panel alert (Sidebar + 4–6 KPI columns + alert panel)
- iPad: Rail navigasi + kartu besar 2–3 kolom (Nav rail + large cards in 2–3 columns)
- Mobile: Satu kolom: sapaan, angka, CTA, bottom nav (Single column: greeting, numbers, CTA, bottom nav)
- Layar (8): HOM-OPR-001, HOM-DRV-001, HOM-SPV-001, HOM-MGR-001, HOM-FIN-001, HOM-SAL-001, HOM-EXE-001, HOM-CLT-001

### T02 · Work Queue

Daftar pekerjaan berurutan dengan status dan SLA. Tap untuk detail. (Ordered list of work with status and SLA. Tap for detail.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Pickup, Penerimaan, Proses, QC, Packing, Pengiriman (Pickup, Receiving, Production, QC, Packing, Delivery)
- Header: Nama antrian + jumlah (Queue name + count)
- Area status: Tab status sederhana (Semua / Mendesak) + chip SLA (Simple status tabs (All / Urgent) + SLA chip)
- Konten utama: Kartu ringkas: klien, berat, bag, status. Diurutkan dari SLA paling dekat. (Short cards: client, weight, bags, status. Sorted by nearest SLA.)
- Memuat (Loading): 3 kartu kerangka (3 skeleton cards)
- Kosong (Empty): Belum ada cucian yang menunggu. (Nothing is waiting.)
- PC: Daftar + panel detail di kanan (List + detail panel on the right)
- iPad: Kartu besar, satu kolom, tab di atas (Large cards, one column, tabs on top)
- Mobile: Kartu penuh lebar, tap untuk buka (Full-width cards, tap to open)
- Layar (12): OPS-TSK-001, OPS-PKP-002, OPS-RCV-002, OPS-SRT-002, OPS-WSH-002, OPS-QC-002, OPS-PAC-002, OPS-DLV-002, OPS-HIS-001, LOG-RTE-001, OPS-BRD-001, CLT-ORD-001

### T03 · Task Detail

Identitas transaksi, klien, status, instruksi, jumlah, waktu dan aksi berikutnya. (Transaction identity, client, status, instructions, quantities, times and next action.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Detail cucian, invoice, status pesanan (Load detail, invoice, order status)
- Header: ID transaksi + klien + chip status (Transaction ID + client + status chip)
- Area status: Progress tahapan + SLA (Stage progress + SLA)
- Konten utama: Jumlah penting, instruksi, catatan, bukti, riwayat (Key quantities, instructions, notes, proof, history)
- Memuat (Loading): Kerangka header dan progress (Header and progress skeleton)
- Kosong (Empty): Data tidak ditemukan. Kembali ke daftar. (Record not found. Back to the list.)
- PC: Dua kolom: detail + panel konteks (Two columns: detail + context panel)
- iPad: Satu kolom, progress horizontal (Single column, horizontal progress)
- Mobile: Satu kolom, progress ringkas, CTA di bawah (Single column, compact progress, CTA at the bottom)
- Layar (3): OPS-TRK-001, FIN-INV-002, CLT-ORD-002

### T04 · Quick Action

Satu tugas, satu tombol utama. Data yang sudah ada diisi otomatis. (One task, one main button. Known data is prefilled.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Terima Cucian, Mulai Cuci, Selesai Cuci, Lulus QC, Siap Dikirim (Receive Laundry, Start Wash, Finish Wash, Pass QC, Ready to Ship)
- Header: Nama aksi + klien • nomor order (Action name + client • order number)
- Area status: Status saat ini + sisa SLA (Current status + SLA left)
- Konten utama: Hanya field yang wajib, angka besar, foto opsional (Only required fields, large numbers, optional photo)
- Memuat (Loading): Tombol utama terkunci + "Menyimpan…" (cegah dobel kirim) (Main button locked + "Saving…" (prevents double submit))
- Kosong (Empty): Tugas ini sudah selesai. Lanjut ke tugas berikutnya. (This task is already done. Go to the next task.)
- PC: Form di tengah + info di samping, CTA besar (Centered form + side info, large CTA)
- iPad: Field besar 3 kolom, CTA penuh lebar (Large fields in 3 columns, full-width CTA)
- Mobile: Satu kolom, CTA menempel di bawah (Single column, CTA pinned at the bottom)
- Layar (9): OPS-PKP-001, OPS-RCV-001, OPS-SRT-001, OPS-WSH-001, OPS-QC-001, OPS-QC-003, OPS-PAC-001, OPS-DLV-001, OPS-DLV-003

### T05 · Management List

Daftar master/transaksi dengan cari, filter dan aksi per baris. (Master/transaction list with search, filters and row actions.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Klien, Kontrak, Invoice, Kendaraan, User, Master Data (Client, Contract, Invoice, Vehicle, User, Master Data)
- Header: Judul + jumlah + tombol tambah (jika diizinkan) (Title + count + add button (if permitted))
- Area status: Filter bar: tanggal, klien, property, status, SLA, cabang, layanan (Filter bar: date, client, property, status, SLA, branch, service)
- Konten utama: Desktop: tabel. Mobile: kartu. (Desktop: table. Mobile: cards.)
- Memuat (Loading): Baris tabel kerangka (Skeleton table rows)
- Kosong (Empty): Belum ada data. Tambahkan data pertama. (No data yet. Add the first record.)
- PC: Tabel penuh + filter lanjutan + export (Full table + advanced filters + export)
- iPad: Tabel ringkas 4–5 kolom (Compact 4–5 column table)
- Mobile: Kartu per baris, filter di sheet (Card per row, filters in a sheet)
- Layar (19): OPS-TEAM-001, QLT-ISS-001, LOG-FLT-001, INV-STK-001, FIN-BIL-001, FIN-INV-001, FIN-PAY-002, FIN-CN-001, COM-CLI-001, COM-PRP-001, COM-CTR-001, COM-RTC-001, COM-SLA-001, COM-DOC-001, COM-RNW-001, RPT-LIB-001, CLT-DLV-001, CLT-INV-001, CLT-DOC-001

### T06 · Form

Input dan edit data dengan validasi yang mudah dibaca. (Input and edit with human-readable validation.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Tambah Klien, Buat Kontrak, Pembayaran, Master Data (Add Client, Create Contract, Payment, Master Data)
- Header: Judul form + konteks (Form title + context)
- Area status: Ringkasan error di atas jika ada (Error summary on top when present)
- Konten utama: Field berkelompok, wajib ditandai *, pesan di bawah field (Grouped fields, required marked *, messages under fields)
- Memuat (Loading): Tombol Simpan terkunci + "Menyimpan…" (Save button locked + "Saving…")
- Kosong (Empty): —
- PC: Dua kolom field (Two field columns)
- iPad: Dua kolom, field lebih tinggi (Two columns, taller fields)
- Mobile: Satu kolom, tombol Simpan di bawah (Single column, Save at the bottom)
- Layar (9): OPS-ISS-001, INV-ADJ-001, FIN-PAY-001, FIN-CN-002, COM-CLI-002, COM-CTR-002, COM-RTC-002, CLT-PKP-001, CLT-CMP-001

### T07 · Approval

Antrian persetujuan dengan nilai lama vs baru dan alasan. (Approval queue with old vs new value and reason.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Perubahan harga, credit note, klaim, penyesuaian stok, koreksi invoice (Rate change, credit note, claim, stock adjustment, invoice correction)
- Header: Persetujuan + jumlah menunggu (Approvals + count waiting)
- Area status: Tab: Menunggu / Disetujui / Ditolak (Tabs: Waiting / Approved / Rejected)
- Konten utama: Kartu permintaan: jenis, pengaju, nilai lama → baru, alasan (Request card: type, requester, old → new value, reason)
- Memuat (Loading): Tombol Setujui/Tolak terkunci saat diproses (Approve/Reject locked while processing)
- Kosong (Empty): Tidak ada yang menunggu persetujuan. (Nothing waiting for approval.)
- PC: Tabel + panel detail (Table + detail panel)
- iPad: Kartu besar (Large cards)
- Mobile: Kartu, tombol Setujui besar (Cards, large Approve button)
- Layar (2): QLT-ISS-002, APR-INB-001

### T08 · Analytics / Report

Ringkasan dulu: KPI, tren, lalu drill-down. (Summary first: KPI, trend, then drill-down.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Revenue, Volume, SLA, Quality, Finance, Produktivitas (Revenue, Volume, SLA, Quality, Finance, Productivity)
- Header: Judul laporan + periode + export (jika diizinkan) (Report title + period + export (if permitted))
- Area status: Baris KPI dengan tren (KPI row with trends)
- Konten utama: Grafik tren + tabel rincian (dimuat belakangan) (Trend chart + detail table (lazy loaded))
- Memuat (Loading): KPI dulu, grafik dimuat belakangan (KPI first, charts lazy loaded)
- Kosong (Empty): Belum ada data di periode ini. (No data in this period.)
- PC: KPI 4–6 kolom + grafik + tabel (4–6 KPI columns + chart + table)
- iPad: KPI 2–3 kolom + grafik (2–3 KPI columns + chart)
- Mobile: KPI 2 kolom, grafik ringkas, tabel jadi kartu (2 KPI columns, compact chart, table becomes cards)
- Layar (9): SLA-MON-001, RPT-OPS-001, PRD-DSH-001, QLT-DSH-001, FIN-AR-001, RPT-FIN-001, RPT-COM-001, RPT-CLI-001, RPT-PPL-001

### T09 · System / Settings

User, peran, izin, workflow, audit, master data dan pengaturan. (Users, roles, permissions, workflow, audit, master data and settings.)

- Dipakai untuk (Used for): Users, Roles, Permissions, Workflow, Audit, Master Data, Settings
- Header: Judul + sub-navigasi sistem (Title + system sub-navigation)
- Area status: Ringkasan perubahan terakhir (Last change summary)
- Konten utama: Daftar/matriks pengaturan, semua perubahan tercatat di audit (Settings list/matrix, every change audited)
- Memuat (Loading): Kerangka daftar (List skeleton)
- Kosong (Empty): Belum ada data. (No data yet.)
- PC: Sub-nav kiri + konten (Left sub-nav + content)
- iPad: Sub-nav jadi tab (Sub-nav becomes tabs)
- Mobile: Daftar menu, buka per halaman (Menu list, one page at a time)
- Layar (6): SYS-HUB-001, SYS-USR-001, SYS-ROL-001, SYS-AUD-001, SYS-MD-001, SYS-SET-001
